notes: High-level: mid-stage evaluation for contact-center automation focused on billing disputes and PHI-sensitive workflows.
Primary contact: Suresh Patel (Head of Customer Ops) - prefers technical deep dives; expressed need for non-repudiable audit trails.
Security gating: must run in customer VPC with KMS integration, full audit logs forwarded to their SIEM, 7-year retention on dispute transcripts per compliance team.
Quote from call (2026-02-18): "We cannot have any part of the inference plane in a shared tenancy that could expose PANs or PHI. End-to-end traceability is mandatory."
Cost sensitivity moderate — willing to pay for predictable capacity during month-end billing spikes, but wants Optimize recommendations to reduce token spend on low-priority flows.
Preference for model variants that support deterministic tool-calling (ticket ticketing APIs) and function signatures for agent UI integration.
Legal requested SOC2 Type II report and pen-test rubric; security team asked for an architectural runbook and incident response playbook.
Internal note: potential to expand to fraud-alerting if PoC meets latency/throughput (target 95th percentile < 220ms for agent-assist in voice transcription paths).
AE notes: good rapport, likes the latency benchmarks from our dedicated page; asked for a canary rollout plan and automatic fallback to smaller models under overload.

summary_requirements: Workload: agent_assist (voice->transcript->reply), ticket_summarization, automated tool-calling into their ticket system
Latency target: 95th pct < 220ms for text-only agent assist; < 500ms end-to-end for transcript->suggestion pipeline
Throughput: baseline 250 reqs/sec, spike tolerance to 1,200 reqs/sec during month-end billing windows
Availability: SLA required for dedicated clusters; automatic fallback to cheaper model variants without exposing PHI
Data controls: enforce no model caching of PHI outside customer-managed KV store; exportable audit logs and immutable retention
Integrations: SAML SSO, KMS key rotation, SIEM log forwarding, ticketing system webhooks (tool-calling)
poc_plan: Scope: 4 weeks, validate latency/throughput targets on dedicated GPUs inside customer VPC; run simulated spikes and canary rollouts
Success metrics: latency SLOs met at 95th pct, tool-call reliability > 99%, ticket summary accuracy (human eval) >= 90%
Deliverables: network diagram, SOW draft, test harness for spike simulation, sample audit log export, runbook for failover
Milestones: network peering demo -> security questionnaire completion -> pen-test window -> SOW signoff -> POC start
